subject: SDR stack rightsize + seat credits and renewal path
body:
From: Liz Gomez <liz@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal options + seat re-balance question

Hi Kimberly,

We’re kicking off renewal planning and I wanted to surface two asks from the SDR org:
- Can we move 40 seats from Outreach to a HubSpot/Sequencing mix for some cross-functional teams?
- Is there a credits/true-up path if we over- or under-utilize for three months?

Procurement is copied — they’ll need a clear cost path and any contract addendum. We’re looking to lock something down by end of month.

Thanks,
Liz Gomez
Head of SDRs, Acme Corp

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Liz Gomez <liz@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal options + seat re-balance question

Hi Liz — appreciate the heads up. Quick summary of feasible paths so we can align with Procurement: 

1) Hybrid seat pool: We can offer a combined license pool (Outreach + HubSpot sequencing) with monthly reallocation windows. Pricing would be blended and we can hold a fixed conversion rate for 90 days to simplify forecasts.

2) Pilot reallocation: Move 40 seats for a 90-day pilot with a prorated credit if usage is below 70% of the pilot pool. If usage exceeds the pilot by >20%, there’s a predefined upgrade path at a negotiated per-seat price.

3) True-up + credit bucket: Offer an annual true-up but with a 3-month buffer and a small credit bucket (e.g., $15k) that offsets minor overages during the transition.

I’ll pull exact numbers and contract language. Marissa — can you run two scenarios (hybrid pool vs pilot) and include attachments that Procurement can send to their legal? Karthik — flag any quota/SLAs we need to expose.

Internal note: aim to keep annual spend neutral to slightly favorable for Acme; we’re prioritizing keeping the business fully on a supported path to avoid churn.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops (Redwood Inference)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Liz Gomez <liz@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 14:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal options + seat re-balance question

Kimberly / Liz — attaching two artifacts: 1) Outreach_Pricing_v3.pdf with blended pricing and pilot amortization, and 2) SeatAllocation_Spreadsheet.xlsx showing headcount scenarios across Q3–Q4. Key bullets: 
- Hybrid pool: blended per-seat rate = $38/month (annualized) if minimum 1-year term; reallocation windows quarterly.
- 90-day pilot: prorated charge for 40 seats = $6,800 for the pilot window; credit applied if average utilization <70% (credit = 50% of pilot cost).
- True-up: annual true-up with a 3-month voluntary buffer; small credit bucket of $12,500 to absorb minor overages during migration.

Legal asks we prepped: sample addendum to allow seat movement, defined metrics for utilization, and predefined escalation path if usage spikes. See Outreach_Pricing_v3.pdf (page 4).

Liz — procurement will want the exact DocuSign flow; I added a sample SOW link to the related_links. Happy to hop on a quick call with Procurement if helpful.

Attachments: Outreach_Pricing_v3.pdf (pricing and addendum draft), SeatAllocation_Spreadsheet.xlsx (headcount scenarios)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Renewals & Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Liz Gomez <liz@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 18:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal options + seat re-balance question

All — quick confirmation from infra/SLAs: moving seats between Outreach and HubSpot sequencing is operationally fine; two things to note for the contract: 
- We need a clear definition of "utilization" (active seat vs assigned seat). Recommend "active seat = seat with >=1 outbound action/week" for pilot metrics.
- SLA for API throughput when using HubSpot sequencing plus Outreach routing should be captured; we can offer a rollback clause if response latency exceeds 300ms p95 for >2 consecutive weeks.

If that works, I’ll add the utilization definition and SLA snippet to the addendum for legal.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

---

[Thread summary]
- First email: Acme asks about moving 40 seats and credits/true-up options.
- Internal plan: two commercial paths (hybrid pool or 90-day pilot) and a suggested credit bucket.
- Artifacts attached for Procurement and Legal.
- Next steps: Kimberly to propose preferred path by EOD Friday; Marissa to share final numbers and DocuSign flow; Karthik to attach utilization + SLA language to the addendum.
